SAMPLE SIZE.evidence_source: The LI scores of the eminent creative achievers (M 11.1, SD 7.6) were significantly lower than the LI scores of the control group (M 19.4, SD 10.5), t(46) 3.17, p .004, d .93 (Mann–Whitney U: Z 2.65, p .008). The degrees of freedom for the t-test are 46. For an independent samples t-test, df = N1 + N2 - 2. Therefore, N1 + N2 = 46 + 2 = 48. This is the total sample size for the comparison.

section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a study comparing Latent Inhibition (LI) scores between eminent creative achievers and a control group. The eminent creative achievers (N=25) had significantly lower LI scores (M=11.1) than the control group (M=19.4), with a total sample size of 48 for the t-test comparison. Eminent creative achievers were also seven times more likely to have low LI scores.
